name: Aletta
source:
An adventure visual novel with a pixel art style. About ghosts, past love, and a world of the unconscious.

It has a simple click-to-advance mechanic, with minimalistic controls.
Will you follow the scent of spider lilies, or will you ride again the engine steam?
Or maybe, both?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1980400/Aletta__Visual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部像素风格的冒险视觉小说，讲述幽灵、旧日恋情与无意识世界。

游戏采用简单的点击推进机制，操作极为简洁。
你会循着彼岸花的香气前行，还是再次乘上蒸汽列车？
又或者，两者兼而有之？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1980400/Aletta__Visual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
